tools.name: sharepoint_search_documents
tools.description: Full-text/semantic search over designated SharePoint sites for SOPs, OEM manuals, and RCA reports matching a query, equipment type, or document library scope.

tools.name: sharepoint_vector_search
tools.description: Query the RAG vector index of embedded SOPs and historical RCA reports for the top-N nearest neighbors to a failure signature or symptom description.

tools.name: sharepoint_get_document
tools.description: Retrieve a specific document's content and metadata (title, version, effective date, section references) by its SharePoint URL or document ID.

tools.name: sharepoint_publish_rca_report
tools.description: Upload a finalized RCA report document into the 'AI-Generated RCA Reports' subfolder, tagged with IncidentID, Equipment, and RootCauseCategory metadata. Requires human (maintenance engineer) approval prior to invocation; must not be called to publish an unapproved draft.
